kubejs.ponder.chiaroscuro_forge.text_1: First, build the casing shell with the Schematicannon.
kubejs.ponder.chiaroscuro_forge.text_2: Shadow Steel and Refined Radiance casings must alternate to bind light and darkness.
kubejs.ponder.chiaroscuro_forge.text_3: Place the Chiaroscuro Forge inside the hollow core.
kubejs.ponder.chiaroscuro_forge.text_4: Feed it a Chromatic Compound and a fluid.
kubejs.ponder.chiaroscuro_forge.text_5: The Chiaroscuro Forge now refines Radiance and Shadow Steel.
kubejs.ponder.circuit_etcher.text_1: First, build the pressure chamber with the Schematicannon.
kubejs.ponder.circuit_etcher.text_2: Inside, sit the Drill and Lazer Assembly Program on the Platform.
kubejs.ponder.circuit_etcher.text_3: Place the Circuit Etcher in front of the chamber.
kubejs.ponder.circuit_etcher.text_5: The Circuit Etcher now etches Printed Circuit Boards.
kubejs.ponder.dimensional_stabilizer.tex: First, build the ritual structure with the Schematicannon.
Place the Dimensional Stabilizer at the core of the structure.
Set Ice Shards on one or all four Arcane Pedestals.
Ice Shards are transmuted into Dimensional Shards.
kubejs.ponder.precision_assembler.text_1: First, build the main structure with the Schematicannon.
kubejs.ponder.precision_assembler.text_2: Place the Precision Assembler at the heart of the frame.
kubejs.ponder.precision_assembler.text_3: Supply rotational force at the bottom to drive the assembly.
kubejs.ponder.precision_assembler.text_4: Belts carry the components from one edge
kubejs.ponder.precision_assembler.text_6: The Precision Assembler is now ready to craft advanced components.
kubejs.ponder.singularity_extractor.head: Singularity Extractor
kubejs.ponder.singularity_extractor.text: First, build the main structure with the Schematicannon.
Place a temporary support block at the center.
Drop a Corrupti Dust and a Dark Matter to create a Black Hole.
Be careful - the Black Hole absorbs any nearby dropped items!
You can now remove the support block.
Place the Singularity Extractor on top of the structure.
Provide energy to activate the structure.
The Singularity Extractor is now fully operational.
kubejs.ponder.soul_harvester.text_1: First, build the ritual altar with the Schematicannon.
kubejs.ponder.soul_harvester.text_2: Place an Unholy Symbol on the left Stone Hand and a Holy Symbol on the right one.
kubejs.ponder.soul_harvester.text_3: Set a Lesser Soul Gem on the central Brazier.
kubejs.ponder.soul_harvester.text_4: Place the Soul Harvester in front of the altar.
kubejs.ponder.soul_harvester.text_5: The Soul Harvester now draws wandering souls into Soul Shards.
